review_type: bounded extraction QA against rendered original PDF pages
coverage: At least one sampled page from each annual 2021-2025, plus Q3 2026 narrative and Note 5. No exhaustive page verification; Q1/H1 not visually sampled.
overall_verdict: Native text is usable for the retrieval experiment with explicit extraction limitations and visual fallback; it is not a verified numeric dataset.

observations: Image value 7,163 appears as 7,1 6 3 in extracted external net sales.
Image value 7,951 appears as 7, 9 51 in extracted external net sales.
Image value 7.2 appears as 7. 2 in internal sales volume.
SEK million, ktonnes, year headings, segment names and footnote remain present; flat text does not encode explicit column groups.
findings.recommendation: Flag this table for image or layout-aware table verification before numeric reuse. Preserve raw extraction. Avoid blanket whitespace deletion because adjacent columns may merge.
findings.missing_evidence: Other pages may contain similar artifacts; no full-corpus numeric reconciliation performed.

findings.verdict: page reading-order change confirmed; target note content survives
findings.section: Financial statements, Notes 4-6 and continuation of loans text
observations: Rendered order: loans continuation, Note 4, Note 5, Note 6.
Extracted order: Note 4, share capital table, Note 6 body, loans continuation, Note 5.
Note 5 preserves quarter/YTD headers, SEK million, -49 and -64, composition of SEK 64 million, and no insurance compensation recognized.
Share-capital prose has numeric whitespace artifacts such as 132,27 4.
findings.recommendation: Use page/section tools that include full note context and visual fallback; do not infer adjacency from extraction order. A layout-aware pass should be evaluated if section ordering matters.
findings.missing_evidence: No proof that other complex pages retain all note/body associations.

findings.verdict: low text is legitimate, not OCR failure
observations: Page 1 is a cover with a photo and report title; extracted title survives.
Page 27 is a photo divider with THE BUSINESS and Markets / Granges Eurasia / Granges Americas; those headings survive.
Brand logo and text incidentally photographed on equipment are not needed as financial narrative.
findings.recommendation: Classify as cover/divider after visual check. Do not trigger OCR solely from low character count.
findings.missing_evidence: This finding covers only these two low-text pages.

findings.verdict: simple table usable with page-label and whitespace cautions
findings.section: Consolidated income statement and comprehensive income
observations: Both table titles, SEK million, 2021/2020 headings, figures and material-cost footnotes remain present.
Side-by-side tables linearize as complete first table then complete second table, which is readable.
Net sales 18,130 appears as 18, 130; navigation headings concatenate at the end.
Physical PDF page 74 differs from printed page 71.
findings.recommendation: Cite physical PDF pages explicitly; retain a printed-label field when verified. Keep table strings out of numeric inputs until reconciled.
findings.missing_evidence: Only one simple financial-statement page checked.

findings.verdict: narrative readable; decorative ordering and line wrapping persist
observations: Annual2023 body and side pull-quote are readable and kept separate by ordering, but page6 ends mid-sentence before continuation on page7; next-page context matters.
Line-wrap hyphenation remains, for example strength- / ening.
Q3 body and fourth-quarter outlook are coherent; main heading Another record quarter is inserted after the left-column body.
findings.recommendation: Retain page sequence and allow adjacent-page reads. Do not use heading order alone as a trustworthy document hierarchy.
findings.missing_evidence: No check of every narrative layout.

findings.verdict: table data and header text survive; hierarchy remains implicit
findings.section: Notes 6 and 7: operating segments and geographic breakdown
observations: 2024/2023 column groups, regional headings, SEK million, ktonnes, rows and footnotes remain in text.
Rendered shading and explicit grouping are lost. Repeated segment headers require positional interpretation.
Navigation menu appears at end of text.
findings.recommendation: Provide rendered-page fallback for column binding and avoid treating flattened tables as structured records.
findings.missing_evidence: No machine check of every cell or row.

recommended_next_steps: Keep the experiment input fixed and disclose these shared extraction limitations.
Expose source page renders for flagged numerical tables and order-sensitive note questions.
Add physical PDF page versus verified printed label distinction.
